mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in the month preceding the decision date is associated with a subsequent negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 0.3 in the month prior to decision_date
failure_condition: Over a 5-year rolling window, the 20-day forward return is not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes above 0.3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate wage growth will support consumer demand.
failure_condition: Across 10 event windows of PAYEMS > 0.5%, the 60-day forward return mean is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in both HOUST and RSAFS for two consecutive months signals weakening demand, leading to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prev and RSAFS < prev in the same month
failure_condition: During 5 such events, the 20-day forward return mean is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO supply index below 100 coincides with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates production softness and potential supply constraints.
failure_condition: Over 8 such events, the 5-day forward return is never statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS for three consecutive months, without a compensating rise in UNRATE, predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as markets price in lower policy tightening.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < prev for 3 months and UNRATE <= prev over same period
failure_condition: During 4 such episodes, the 20-day forward return mean is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 4% triggers a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as higher labor market participation costs are expected to weigh on corporate earnings.
regime_hint: high unemployment or participation rate scenario
failure_condition: Across 6 such events, the 60-day forward return mean is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4.25% for two consecutive months in a non-recessionary macro regime, the S&P 500 exhibits a positive 20-day forward return as markets price in persistent higher policy rates.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.25 for 2 consecutive months and macro regime is non-recessionary
failure_condition: During 7 such episodes, the 20-day forward return mean is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (industrial activity) by at least 2% in the same month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals dual softening in consumption and production.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < prev - 2% and HOUST < prev - 2% in the current month
failure_condition: During 3 such events, the 20-day forward return mean is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
